sync.title: Syncing
sync.description: Sync your bookmarks across devices using an ID, encryption key, and shared secret. Your data is encrypted locally before being uploaded.
sync.generate_confirm: Generating new credentials will replace your current ones. If you have synced data on the server, you will lose access to it unless you have backed up the old credentials. Continue?
sync.clock_behind: Your device's clock is {amount} behind the sync server's. Sync corrects for this, but other apps and websites may not: check your date, time and time zone settings.
sync.clock_ahead: Your device's clock is {amount} ahead of the sync server's. Sync corrects for this, but other apps and websites may not: check your date, time and time zone settings.

errors.invalid_credentials: Sync failed: the credentials are not in the ID:EncKey:Secret format.
errors.network: Sync failed: could not reach the sync server.
errors.unauthorized: Sync failed: the server did not accept these credentials. Check that the secret is correct.
errors.clock: Sync failed: your device's clock is more than 5 minutes off. Check your date, time and time zone settings.
errors.wrong_origin: Sync failed: this sync ID is locked to a different website.
errors.rate_limited: Sync failed: too many requests. It will try again shortly.
errors.server: Sync failed: the sync server returned an error ({status}).
errors.decrypt: Sync failed: the data on the server could not be decrypted. Check your encryption key.
errors.remote_unreadable: Sync stopped: the data on the server could not be read, so it was not overwritten.
errors.unknown: Sync failed because of an unexpected error. See the browser console for details.
errors.weak_credentials: Sync failed: these credentials are too weak. Create new ones with the generate button, shown while sync is off.

sync.credentials_weak: These credentials are too weak: the encryption key and secret must each be at least 32 hexadecimal characters, like generated ones. Create new ones with the generate button, shown while sync is off.

about.title: About Bookmarks
about.description: A simple, private, and encrypted bookmark manager. This app is designed to be lightweight, offline-first, and secure.

features.title: Features
items: **End-to-End Encryption**: Your data is encrypted in your browser using your sync credentials. Nobody else can read your bookmarks.
**Offline Access**: Works without an internet connection as a Progressive Web App (PWA).
**Fast & Minimal**: No bloat, no tracking, just your bookmarks.

usage.title: Usage Tips
items: **Tags**: Use tags to group your bookmarks. Filter by a tag from the tag row or sidebar, and star the tags you use most so they come first.
**Sync**: Set up a sync URL and credentials in Settings to keep your bookmarks backed up and synced across devices.
**PWA**: Install this app on your home screen or desktop for a native-like experience.

privacy.title: Privacy and GDPR
privacy.content:
This app is built with privacy in mind. All data is stored locally in your browser and encrypted with your sync credentials on the server. We do not collect any personal data or analytics.

If you don't enable sync, no data will ever leave your device. Even with sync enabled, your data is encrypted before it leaves your browser, so we have no access to it.
privacy.contact: If you have any GDPR-related questions or requests, please contact us at {email}

opensource.title: Open Source
opensource.content: This project is open-source and respects your privacy. You can find the source code and contribute on GitHub.
